The first token of any prompt always reads about 0.15 (0.88 of max), and ordinary content tokens in running text (nouns, verbs, subword pieces, newlines) read 0.15-0.17. Single tokens fall to about 0 only when pushed positive (commas, ' and', ' on', sentence-final '.', clause-linking function words) or strongly negative (code/math syntax after context such as ' (', ' $', ' {', ' ==', and first/second-person ' your', ' my', ' got').
